correctness.rationale: Root-of-unity filtering on Ω_n of cardinality (2^n+2(-1)^n)/3 gives odd Walsh moments 0 and even nonempty size 2r moments 2(-1)^n(-3)^r/D. The singleton Gram block and line-graph edge block diagonalize through unsigned incidence B^TB=2I+A, BB^T=(n-2)I+J; coupling of the constant to all-edge vector is a 2x2 block with c=(n-2)(3n-13)/2. This yields exactly six sectors and multiplicities totaling 1+n+binom(n,2). The elementary estimates c>0, h=(sqrt(c^2+4M)-c)/2<sqrt M<4n-13 ensure stated extremizing sectors and positivity n>=8; by parity and monotone exponential corrections the global maximum occurs uniquely at n=8. Explicit vanishing quadratics establish smaller-dimensional failure of injectivity. Independently enumerated all sign vectors at n=8,9,10, rebuilt the full Gram by evaluation, and compared every eigenvalue to closed sectors: max eigenvalue errors <=3.4e-15. Obtained squared condition 3.20115514379848 at n=8, exactly (119+sqrt1201)/48 within 1e-10. Finite checks corroborate universal bounds.
